sec-head.p: Each stage of a multimodal AI pipeline, built and tested as its own verifiable module.

card.p: Building the pipeline that ingests and preprocesses text, images, and audio from your sources into aligned, tokenized representations. This step defines the quality ceiling for all downstream tasks.
Selecting and configuring embedding models (CLIP, ImageBind, Whisper) and vector stores to index multimodal data in a unified space for cross-modal retrieval.
Building retrieval that queries across modalities using hybrid search (text→image, audio→text) with metadata filtering and reranking to maximize relevance.
Configuring generation with grounded constraints, confidence thresholds, and fallback behavior so the model says 'I do not know' instead of hallucinating across modalities.
Testing retrieval and generation quality against real multimodal queries using custom metrics (modality alignment, cross-modal consistency) with transparent results before launch.
Deploying the full multimodal pipeline as a versioned, monitored API integrated with your product or internal tools.
